name: button
title: Button
description: Primary actions with variants, text sizes, icon sizes, and a plain icon-only style.

api.description: Primary actions with variants, text and icon sizes, optional leading or trailing content, loading state, and a corner count badge. plain is the icon-only variant with no resting plate. Use transparent on outline to drop the resting fill.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the button. plain is icon-only chrome with no resting plate; hover and focus expand a soft pad around the glyph without shifting layout. Use ghost for labeled transparent actions on UI chrome. Prefer plain on media, gradients, and dense overlays. Give plain buttons an aria-label. link is inline text with no control height or horizontal padding. On outline, set transparent to drop the resting fill.

props.name: size
props.description: Text sizes use padding, type size, and line height (xs to 2xl). Height follows those tokens unless you set height. Icon sizes are square controls (icon-2xs to icon-2xl) on the form control height tokens. Override padding, size, type, font, and radius with chrome props or --df-button-* variables. plain requires an icon size; the resting box matches the glyph for that step. If plain is paired with a text size, size falls back to icon-xs.

props.name: underline
props.description: Link variant only. When true, show underline on hover. Set false to keep the label plain on hover.

props.name: transparent
props.description: Outline variant only. When true, drop the resting fill (data-transparent). Theme the filled plate with --df-button-outline-fill. Hover and expanded washes stay for affordance. Ignored on other variants.

props.name: leading
props.description: Content before the label, such as an icon.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content after the label, such as an icon or badge.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a Spinner in the icon area, keeps the label, and disables the control. Unsupported on the link variant. Supported on plain icon sizes.

props.name: loadingPlacement
props.description: Which icon slot shows the Spinner while loading. Ignored for icon-only sizes, which replace the icon child.

props.name: loadingAppearance
props.description: muted fades the whole control like disabled. solid keeps the default background, fades the label only, and leaves the Spinner at full opacity.

props.name: badge
props.description: Corner count badge anchored to the top end of the button. Count ink is optically centered to cap height with text-box when available, and a 1cap line box otherwise. Hidden when empty, null, or 0. Include the count in aria-label for icon buttons.

props.name: badgeVariant
props.description: Badge visual style. Defaults to secondary on the default button variant, otherwise default, so the count stays readable on dark fills.

props.name: badgePosition
props.description: edge sits on the corner. inset pulls the badge a notch inside the button.

props.name: badgeSide
props.description: Which top corner hosts the badge. end is the trailing side (right in left to right layouts). start is the leading side.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles.

groups.title: Chrome overrides
groups.description: String props write --df-button-* on the host. Prefer token expressions such as var(--df-text-sm), var(--df-font-sans), var(--radius-md), or calc(4 * var(--spacing-unit)). Size still supplies defaults when a prop is omitted. On dfButtonClass hosts, pass the same values through dfButtonChromeStyle into style.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on all sides. Sets --df-button-padding-block-start, --df-button-padding-block-end, --df-button-padding-inline-start, and --df-button-padding-inline-end.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal padding. Sets --df-button-padding-inline-start and --df-button-padding-inline-end. Overrides padding on those sides.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical padding. Sets --df-button-padding-block-start and --df-button-padding-block-end. Overrides padding on those sides.

props.name: paddingTop
props.description: Top padding. Sets --df-button-padding-block-start and wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingRight
props.description: Trailing-edge padding. Sets --df-button-padding-inline-end and wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.description: Bottom padding. Sets --df-button-padding-block-end and wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.description: Leading-edge padding. Sets --df-button-padding-inline-start and wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: height
props.description: Control height. Default auto so height follows padding and line height. Sets --df-button-height.

props.name: width
props.description: Control width. Default auto so width follows content and padding. Sets --df-button-width.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Label type size. Prefer type tokens such as var(--df-text-sm). Sets --df-button-font-size.

props.name: lineHeight
props.description: Label line height. Prefer leading tokens such as var(--df-leading-5). Sets --df-button-line-height.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: Label font family. Prefer family tokens such as var(--df-font-sans) or var(--df-font-mono). Sets --df-button-font-family.

props.name: fontWeight
props.description: Label font weight. Prefer weight tokens such as var(--df-font-weight-medium). Sets --df-button-font-weight.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius. Prefer radius tokens such as var(--radius-md). Default is --radius-4xl. Sets --df-button-radius.

groups.title: Helpers
groups.description: Class helper for applying button styles to a host that is not a button.

props.name: dfButtonClass
props.description: Builds the same class string Button uses internally. Resolves plain with a non-icon size to icon-xs, matching Button. For link hosts, set the underline data attribute to hover or none to match the underline prop. For outline hosts without a resting fill, set data-transparent.

props.name: dfButtonChromeStyle
props.description: Writes the same --df-button-* variables the chrome props set on Button. Merge into style on a dfButtonClass host.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-label-line-height
props.description: Line box for label flex centering. Defaults to --df-leading-none. When text-box is unavailable and the cap unit is supported, the kit sets this to 1cap so flex centering matches cap-height ink.

props.name: --df-corner-shape
props.description: Theme corner curve for all kit chrome. round = circular arcs; smooth = continuous squircle. Set with df-ui init --corner-shape, or override on :root. Default round.
